title: Teamwork and Life Experience
summary: Cooperation, collaboration, biography, and life experiences.
whyItMatters: Teamwork language helps people share experience, divide responsibilities, explain strengths, and reflect on what made cooperation successful.

mentalModel.title: Team equals goal, roles, process
mentalModel.content: Identify the shared result, each person's responsibility, and how information and decisions move.

mentalModel.title: Experience supports contribution
mentalModel.content: Connect a past activity or skill to what someone can do in the current project.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe roles and responsibilities
ruleBlocks.content: Use zuständig sein für, übernehmen, unterstützen, koordinieren, and entscheiden.

ruleBlocks.title: State relevant experience
ruleBlocks.content: Name what you did, for how long, and what you learned from it.

ruleBlocks.title: Evaluate cooperation concretely
ruleBlocks.content: Discuss communication, reliability, participation, conflict, and results.

examples.de: Mina ist für die Organisation der Termine zuständig.
examples.en: Mina is responsible for organizing the appointments.

examples.de: Ich habe schon einmal bei einem internationalen Projekt mitgearbeitet.
examples.en: I have worked on an international project before.

examples.de: Die Zusammenarbeit war erfolgreich, weil alle zuverlässig informiert haben.
examples.en: The collaboration was successful because everyone communicated reliably.

commonMistakes.reason: Zusammenarbeiten separates in a main clause.

commonMistakes.correct: Add a relevant task or experience.

comparisons.summary: Teamwork uses fixed phrases such as sich kümmern um and teilnehmen an.
The communication lesson keeps joint work clear and interactive.
